name: Meta Graph API
tagline: Meta's REST API for Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Pages data
description: The Meta Graph API is the primary way for apps to read and write data on Facebook and related Meta products. Developers use it to manage Pages, posts, ads insights, Instagram Business accounts, Messenger, and WhatsApp Business Platform resources via versioned HTTPS endpoints and OAuth access tokens.

auth.details: OAuth 2.0 user/page/app access tokens (often as access_token query param or Authorization: Bearer). App created in Meta for Developers; many scopes need App Review.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Platform API access is free; ads/marketing spend and WhatsApp conversation pricing are separate product costs
pricing.paid_plans: No Graph API subscription tiers; costs may apply for Ads, WhatsApp Business Platform conversations, and other billed Meta products

rate_limits: Platform Rate Limits (app/user/page-level); not a single global RPS. Check X-App-Usage / X-Business-Use-Case-Usage headers; limits vary by endpoint and access token type
use_cases: fetch a Facebook Page's recent posts and engagement metrics
publish or schedule a post to a managed Facebook Page
read Instagram Business account media and insights
send or receive WhatsApp Business messages via Cloud API
query ad account insights and campaign performance
get the authenticated user profile (id, name) with an access token
